title: School Pictures by Milo Cramer at The Cherry Lane Theatre #schoolpict...
transcript: As a tutor and former “Gifted and Talented” kid, Milo Cramer is uniquely familiar with the pressures faced by New York City's up and coming generations. School Pictures is a solo song cycle spotlighting various students and their earnestly contained worldviews. I loved this piece a few years back at Playrights Horizons and I love it now. It feels even more urgent today, with its humor and poignancy taking on an exasperated undertone as the education system continues to struggle, equity continues to hang in the balance, and stability feels increasingly tenuous. With charmingly quirky songs played on small-scale children's instruments, astute musings on youth and education, and an unexpected math lesson, School Pictures more than makes the grade. Don't miss this well-deserved encore engagement at the Cherry Lane Theatre, running now through November 29th.
classificationReason: Creator shares a first-hand opinion of the current Cherry Lane Theatre encore engagement, explicitly contrasting it with their earlier experience at Playwrights Horizons. Praises its humor, poignancy, and urgency, recommending audiences attend.
